cover_refinement: A first cover candidate was rejected for pseudo-writing. The selected cover was regenerated/refined with explicit blank objects and no text; requested high resolution was not the actual output resolution. The final original illustration is placed at 88 mm width, above 300 ppi, within a full-page vector cover design.
reference_use: Owner images guided ink, muted color, parchment, hierarchy and restrained humor. Their pixels, characters, scene layout and invented rules were not inserted into this publication.
native_type: All printed lettering and rules are native PDF text, not image-generated copy.
retained_card_art: All 121 prior original illustration plates and seven shared backs remain byte-identical to the task baseline. No map identity was regenerated.
